name: posato-showcase
description: Posato showcase media: README demo and walkthrough, composed stills, site hero video

scripts.render:hero: remotion render Hero out/hero-master.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p --muted --concurrency 4
scripts.render:walkthrough: remotion render Walkthrough out/walkthrough-master.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --pixel-format yuv420p --muted --concurrency 4
scripts.stills: remotion still StepWebsites ../.github/assets/step-websites.png && remotion still StepDuration ../.github/assets/step-duration.png && remotion still SocialPreview ../.github/assets/social-preview.png
scripts.media: npm run check && npm run render:hero && npm run render:walkthrough && npm run export:gif && npm run export:web && npm run export:attachment && npm run stills && npm run verify
